published_source: Authors' Tables.do line 86 (reghdfe log_hours_S pre_treat post_treat if sample_A==1, a(id crawl_month) clu(id)) re-run in Stata MP 16.1 on data_for_regressions.dta built from the shipped raw data; post_treat coefficient. Article (Management Science) Table 2 Panel A (entry into monopolistic markets), column (1) (Low-demand day, market and month-year FE): post_entry -0.141 (0.061), expected_entry -0.143 (0.067), N 3,804; the re-run equals the print at the printed digits. fixest reproduces reghdfe to machine precision. The same regression's anticipation-bin coefficient pre_treat = -0.1427669 (SE 0.0670048). N = 3804, 106 clusters, outcome SD in regression sample 0.5914185.
notes: Outcome: log hours to Shufersal's earliest delivery slot, Saturday crawl (low-demand day). sample_A: treated pre-entry monopolies (mono==1) plus all never-entered control markets (control==1). Treatment onset Ei = month of first entry by a rival online grocer (Mega, Rami Levy, Victory or Yeinot Bitan); absorbing, no switch-offs, no always-treated markets. The authors' static regression includes an anticipation bin pre_treat (evt_time in {-2,-1}) so post_treat is measured relative to evt_time<=-3 and never-treated markets; run_spec.R's static mode cannot carry an extra regressor; see run_spec_mapping for how the anticipation bin is handled (anticipation rows dropped, onset dated two months early). Eligibility judgment: screened as a two-bin binned event study (anticipation bin + post bin), see log.
run_spec_mapping: Authors' two-bin regression (pre_treat for evt_time in {-2,-1}, post_treat for evt_time>=0, omitted evt_time<=-3 and never-treated) is mapped by dropping the anticipation rows (pre_treat==1) and dating the onset two months early (Ei_shift2 = Ei-2), so that treated rows are exactly the post rows and the comparison set is evt_time<=-3 plus never-treated markets for TWFE, CSA (universal base period = evt_time -3) and BJS (imputation from evt_time<=-3 and never-treated). TWFE on this sample = -0.1408168 (SE 0.0617430) vs published -0.1410268: same estimand, differs only because the dropped rows no longer inform the FE. Literal mapping (onset Ei, all rows, no anticipation bin) gives TWFE -0.1156541 (SE 0.0510464); see log.
